notes.title: UPDATE CRASHES REPORTING
notes.content:
After a lot of work trying to find out what causes occasional crashes, sometimes very frequently kicking you out of the game, making it impossible to enjoy the game, we have managed to come to some proven conclusions that work.

It is true that I can't assure that it will work in 100% of the cases but, until now, in the cases that presented frequent crashes due to a bug in the Unity player, these have stopped happening.

The crashes in these cases were caused by virtual adapters normally used for remote work.
In these cases these apps had to be disabled:

- Virtual Desktop (in this case it was used for VR)
- Citrix workspace

notes.title: UPDATE REWORKED SYSTEMS
notes.content:
UPDATE 16/06/2024

GREAT UPDATED SYSTEMS:

[u]Interactive system reworked[/u]


- Pick/Drag/Drop system has been reworked changing completely physics system.
- Due to the new system all collision have been improved.
- An icon has beed added, not important if you are using "Help mode" or not, in order to know quickly all interactive objects.


[u]Jumping system reworkded[/u]

- Jumping mechanic has suffered modification to avoid wall-stuck and wall-walk present in previous versions.
- Every stage has been adapted to new system.
- Some areas have been modified in platforming stages in order to reduce the difficulty.


[u]Checkpoint system after continue[/u]

- Now when you continue game you will start from last checkpoint you passed. Before it was neccesary restart completely current stage.


[u]Areas Redesigned[/u]

- Several changes have been applied in some stages in order to avoid different problems.
- New lighting replace dark areas.
- Help mode has been expanded including arrows to show correct way in some areas.
- Some areas have been adapted to the new interactive system and reduced in difficulty.

notes.title: Update Remade A
notes.content:
UPDATE 26/05/2024

- Added support elements in Section 2 of interaction tutorial. Now is easier to complete.

- Fixed pulley system in case we try to take it to limit.

- Added highlighted elements included in help mode in several sections to find easier correct way.

- Fixed a problem with jumping in certain conditions that could cause involuntary double jump. 

- Added new elements and slight modifications in: Visions, Rural, Hiking Route, Canyon and Canoe 
Rental.

- In case of Canoe Rental, challenge is modified to make it clearer.
